usage: deskops atoms type [-h] --model MODEL [--id NEW_ID]
                          [--content-field CONTENT_FIELD] [--data DATA]
                          [--root ROOT]
                          doc_id

positional arguments:
  doc_id                Protoatom selector: id or filename.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         Target sldb model name, such as AtomDoc or TaskDoc.
  --id NEW_ID           Id of the typed document; defaults to <model>-<slug>.
  --content-field CONTENT_FIELD
                        Target field that receives the protoatom content;
                        defaults to 'content' when the model has it.
  --data DATA           Inline JSON with the remaining fields the target model
                        requires.
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
